points.text: Methodology notation insufficiently explained, e.g. C_t undefined at first use.
Experiments use only Qwen3-32B; other LLMs not tried.
Three agents plus MARL may be costly; training cost not discussed.
Framework not tested at scale on large real-world noisy knowledge graphs.
Contributions describe the method rather than the problem and differences from prior work.
Related work is a brief RL survey not positioned relative to the paper.
Problem definition imprecise: KG components, question assumptions, and entity linking unspecified.
State notation unclear: subgraph lacks relations, frontier unexplained, C_t undefined.
Agent implementations unclear: what architect and navigator models are, architectures, parameter counts.
Novelty and need for LC-MAPPO over existing Lagrangian RL methods unclear.
EM@1 evaluation metric unclear.
Missing experimental details: which shared LLM, which KG, its scale.
Table 2 bolding implies CLAUSE best though LightRAG is better.
Convergence proof incomplete; relies on assumptions not stated in paper.
Contributions in Section 1 are overclaimed; points should be merged.
Claimed test-time adjustable budgets not demonstrated; no budget sweeps or Pareto plots.
Unclear how policy is conditioned on budgets/prices and whether budgets sampled in training.
Latency reduction claim contradicted: slower than Vanilla RAG and LightRAG.
Predictable runtime never measured (no variance, tail latency, violation rate).
Latency reported only as normalized ratios without absolute times or hardware; steps vs wall-clock conflated.
Constraint experiment budgets inconsistent with main results and mostly infeasible for the method.
Low feasibility rates show unreliable constraint enforcement; dual value misused as quality metric.
Constraint experiment lacks seeds, error bars, accuracy, definitions; only MetaQA.
Training and implementation details missing: reward, episodes, data splits, hyperparameters, architectures.
Algorithms and proofs deferred to unresolved "Appendix ??", so unevaluable.
Convergence with PPO nontrivial; shadow-price claim stronger than warranted.
Combination of QMIX, COMA, MAPPO under-described; adopts mixer restriction criticized in related work.
Architect gain-price rule looks heuristic rather than learned policy; training unclear.
Budgets enforced by truncation, not expectation constraints; hard guarantees unsupported.
How edits feed traversal and curation, and reader input, only sketched.
How a KG is built for HotpotQA is not stated.
EM@1 for FactKG claim verification is unexplained.
MetaQA baseline numbers look odd; CLAUSE below specialized methods.
Missing specialized KGQA baselines and standard benchmarks like WebQSP and CWQ.
Baseline configuration and tuning unclear; RL-trained vs zero-shot; no supervised baseline.
No statistical reporting: seeds, confidence intervals, significance; small ablation gaps.
Token-budget claim only from a figure; no matched-token comparison.
Ablation table dataset and normalization unclear; some variants loosely defined.
"w/o Architect" removes the KG entirely, not isolating the Architect.
No ablations of claimed algorithmic components; RCPO comparison lacks EM.
Provenance quality and neuro-symbolic claims not evaluated.
Case study is a single trivial example.
Presentation: unresolved references, odd phrasing, undefined terminology.
Results text over-interprets findings.
Meaning of "agentic" (small fixed policies) should be stated clearly.
